create.name: Satya Yoga
create.bio:
Satya Yoga is an Iyengar yoga studio on Hørsholmsgade in Nørrebro, Copenhagen, run by Lone Kristensen. She came to the method in 1995 after training as a dancer in London, qualified at the city's long-established Iyengar school, taught on its faculty until 2010 and has travelled to the Pune institute to study with the Iyengar family since 2000. She has also completed a three-year course in the therapeutic application of the method. Anne Christine Remahl and Merete Stentebjerg Hansen teach alongside her, each with the full three-year Iyengar teacher training behind them.

The bright, white practice room is fitted with wall ropes and a full set of props, and groups are kept small so each student gets individual instruction. The timetable runs from introductory Yoga 1 classes and a gentler beginners' class to mixed and more experienced levels, and most classes can also be joined by livestream. Alongside the weekly schedule the studio offers private lessons, small-group and workplace teaching, workshops and residential retreats at a seaside farm on the island of Møn, south of Zealand.

courses.title: Iyengar Yoga – Nye hold for begyndere (Start tilbud)
courses.description: Three beginners' groups a week, each led by one of the studio's teachers, with an eight-class starter card that can be used flexibly across them. A shorter three-class introductory offer is also available.
courses.price: Start tilbud: 8 klasser på 10 uger for kr.560; Intro-tilbud: 3 klasser på 5 uger for kr 225

courses.title: Priser: klippekort og månedskort
courses.description: Class cards of five, ten or fifteen classes over three or four months, or a monthly card for unlimited classes, bought and booked through the studio's online system. Reduced prices are offered to students, the unemployed and pensioners.

courses.title: Eneundervisning og små grupper (private lessons and small groups)
courses.description: One-hour private Iyengar lessons shaped around the student, plus classes for small groups of up to eight and teaching at workplaces.

courses.title: Livestream – Virtuel Yoga
courses.description: Live online versions of the studio's classes and workshops, booked through the same system as in-person classes and joined from home with a mat and a few household props.
